ops.text: IBM further warrants that (i) the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, and (ii) for 90 days following delivery, any software and Materials deliverable provided under this Agreement will conform to its applicable documentation. The warranty in clause (i) applies for 30 days following performance of the applicable Services. Customer's remedy for breach of these warranties is repair, replacement, or a refund of the charges paid for the non-conforming Services or software.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an express warranty that the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner for 30 days following performance, and that software and Materials deliverables will conform to their documentation for 90 days, with repair, replacement or refund as the remedy. Section 5.1 currently gives no conformance warranty, period or remedy; this is our fallback position and we can work with it.
proposal.summary: Insert a professional and workmanlike Services warranty (30 days from performance) and a 90-day software/deliverable documentation-conformance warranty with repair, replacement or refund remedies.
